master-1.change_summary: Command Bar: Move Education to top

data.title: Software Engineer Resume
data.summary: Software engineer with 4+ years of experience designing high-throughput backend services and reactive web applications. Proven track record of reducing latency by 35% and automating CI/CD pipelines.

bullet_points: Architected distributed event-driven ingestion pipeline handling 120,000 events/second using Go, Kafka, and PostgreSQL.
Optimized database query indexes and caching layers in Redis, reducing p99 API query response times from 180ms to 42ms.
Collaborated with cross-functional engineering teams to implement automated end-to-end testing with 88% code coverage.
Developed microservices backend for financial analytics dashboard using Python, FastAPI, and SQLAlchemy.
Designed responsive React and TypeScript UI components with accessible design system guidelines.
Integrated automated GitHub Actions workflows for continuous integration and staging deployments.

projects.name: Distributed Key-Value Engine
projects.description: Fault-tolerant distributed key-value store implementing Raft consensus protocol.
projects.contribution: Engineered leader election and log replication logic.
projects.results: Achieved linearizable read performance across 5 distributed nodes.
bullet_points: Implemented Raft consensus algorithm with dynamic leader election and log compaction routines.
Benchmarked write throughput to 45,000 operations per second under simulated packet loss.
Configured containerized integration tests using Docker Compose and GitHub Actions.
projects.evidence: Raft KV repository with unit tests and benchmark suite

projects.name: Real-time Telemetry Monitor
projects.description: Kernel-level packet inspection monitor built with eBPF and visualized via React dashboard.
projects.contribution: Wrote kernel probes and WebSocket streaming server.
projects.results: Zero overhead live packet latency tracking.
bullet_points: Developed eBPF bytecode programs capturing TCP socket metrics directly from Linux kernel space.
Built streaming WebSocket bridge in Python dispatching telemetry to an interactive React dashboard.
projects.evidence: eBPF C probe source files and frontend telemetry charts

publications: Low Latency Consensus Patterns in Distributed Ledgers (Conference Paper, 2023)
leadership: Peer Mentor - CS Undergrad Mentorship Program
